source_text:
Verse: The thunder glorifies His praises, as do the angels in awe of Him. He sends thunderbolts, striking with them whoever He wills. Yet they dispute about Allah. And He is tremendous in might.

Tafsir: And the thunder — this is an angel who is in charge of the clouds driving them while he constantly proclaims His praise that is he says ‘Glory be to God through His praise’ subhāna’Llāh wa-bi-hamdihi and so too the angels proclaim His praise in awe of Him that is of God. He unleashes the thunderbolts — these are a fire which issues forth from the clouds — and smites with them whom He will such that it burns that person this was revealed regarding a man to whom the Prophet s had sent someone to invite to Islam and who said ‘Who is the Messenger of God? And what is God? Is He made of gold or of silver or of copper?’ whereupon a thunderbolt came down on him and blew off the top of his head; yet they that is the disbelievers dispute argue with the Prophet s about God though He is great in might in power or in the severity of His retribution.

hype_questions: What is the significance of thunder in Islamic theology?
How do angels relate to thunder in the Quran?
What is the nature of God's power and retribution?
propositions: The thunder glorifies Allah's praises.
Angels proclaim Allah's praise in awe of Him.
Allah unleashes thunderbolts that smite whom He wills.
Disbelievers dispute with the Prophet s about God's nature and attributes.
God is tremendous in might.

source_text:
Verse: Calling upon Him ˹alone˺ is the truth. But those ˹idols˺ the pagans invoke besides Him ˹can˺ never respond to them in any way. ˹It is˺ just like someone who stretches out their hands to water, ˹asking it˺ to reach their mouths, but it can never do so. The calls of the disbelievers are only in vain.

Tafsir: His exalted be He is the call of truth that is the words that constitute it the truth and these are ‘there is no god but God’ lā ilāha illā’Llāh; and those upon whom they call read yad‘ūn or tad‘ūn ‘you call’ those whom they worship apart from Him that is other than Him — namely the idols — do not answer them anything of which they ask; save as is the response to one who stretches forth his hands towards water at the edge of a well calling to it that it may reach his mouth by its rising through the well to reach him but it would never reach it that is reach his mouth ever likewise they the idols will not answer them; and the call of the disbelievers their worship of idols — or their actual supplication — goes only astray it is only in perdition.

hype_questions: What is the true call of truth?
How do idols respond to those who worship them?
What happens to the calls of disbelievers?
propositions: Calling upon Him alone is the truth.
Those who invoke idols besides Him cannot be responded to.
The call of the disbeliever is in vain.
Lā ilāha illā'Llāh is the truth that constitutes it.
Idols do not answer those who worship them apart from God.
The worship of idols or actual supplication goes only astray and leads to perdition.

source_text:
Verse: To Allah ˹alone˺ bow down ˹in submission˺ all those in the heavens and the earth—willingly or unwillingly—as do their shadows, morning and evening.

Tafsir: And to God prostrate whoever is in the heavens and the earth willingly such as believers or unwillingly such as hypocrites and those coerced by the sword and their shadows also prostrate in the mornings and the evenings.

source_text:
Verse: Ask ˹them, O  Prophet˺, “Who is the Lord of the heavens and the earth?” Say, “Allah!” Ask ˹them˺, “Why ˹then˺ have you taken besides Him lords who cannot even benefit or protect themselves?” Say, “Can the blind and the sighted be equal? Or can darkness and light be equal?” Or have they associated with Allah partners who ˹supposedly˺ produced a creation like His, leaving them confused between the two creations? Say, “Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is the One, the Supreme.”

Tafsir: Say O Muhammad (s) to your people ‘Who is the Lord of the heavens and the earth?’ Say ‘God’ — and even if they do not say it there can be no other response. Say to them ‘Then have you taken beside Him other than Him protectors idols to worship who have no power to benefit or harm themselves?’ and you abandon the One Who is their Possessor? an interrogative meant as a rebuke. Say ‘Are the blind one and the seer respectively the disbeliever and the believer equal? Or are darkness disbelief and the light faith equal? No! Or have they set up for God associates who have created the like of His creation so that creation seems alike that is is what the associates create and the creation of God alike to them?’ so that they believe them worthy of being worshipped on account of what these associates have created? an interrogative of disavowal; in other words not so! None save the Creator is worthy of being worshipped. Say ‘God is the Creator of all things having no associate therein and so He cannot have an associate in terms of worship; and He is the One the Subjugator’ of His servants.

hype_questions: What is the nature of Allah's creation?
Can humans be equal to Allah in terms of power and wisdom?
Who or what are the 'associates' that people worship alongside Allah?
propositions: Allah is the Lord of the heavens and the earth.
There can be no other response besides 'God' when asked about the Lord of the heavens and the earth.
Idols worshipped by humans have no power to benefit or harm themselves.
The blind and the sighted are not equal in terms of faith or disbelief.
Darkness is not equal to light in terms of faith or disbelief.
God is the Creator of all things, having no associate therein.
Humans should worship only one God, without any associates.

source_text:
Verse: He sends down rain from the sky, causing the valleys to flow, each according to its capacity. The currents then carry along rising foam, similar to the slag produced from metal that people melt in the fire for ornaments or tools. This is how Allah compares truth to falsehood. The ˹worthless˺ residue is then cast away, but what benefits people remains on the earth. This is how Allah sets forth parables.

Tafsir: He then strikes a similitude of truth and falsehood saying He exalted be He sends down water rain from the sky whereat the valleys flow according to their measure according to their full capacity and the flood carries a scum that swells rising above it and this scum is the filth and the like that lies on the surface of the earth and from that which they smelt read tūqidūn ‘you smelt’ or yūqidūn ‘they smelt’ in the fire of the earth’s minerals such as gold silver or copper desiring seeking to make ornaments adornment or ware which is useful such as utensils when they the minerals are melted; there rises a scum the like of it that is the like of the scum of the flood and this latter scum consists of the impurities expelled by the bellows. Thus in the way mentioned God points out truth and falsehood that is He points out the similitude thereof. As for the scum of the flood and of the minerals smelted it passes away as dross useless refuse while that which is of use to mankind in the way of water and minerals lingers remains in the earth for a time likewise falsehood wanes and is eventually effaced even if it should prevail over the truth at certain times. Truth on the other hand is established and enduring. Thus in the way mentioned God strikes He makes clear similitudes.

hype_questions: What is the comparison of truth to falsehood in the Quran?
How does Allah set forth parables?
What happens to the residue of falsehood after it is cast away?
propositions: Allah sends down rain from the sky, causing the valleys to flow according to their capacity.
The currents carry along rising foam similar to the slag produced from metal that people melt in the fire for ornaments or tools.
Truth remains on earth while falsehood wanes and is eventually effaced.
God points out truth and falsehood by striking similitudes.
The scum of the flood and of the minerals smelted passes away as dross useless refuse.
That which is of use to mankind in the way of water and minerals lingers remains in the earth for a time.

source_text:
Verse: Those who respond to ˹the call of˺ their Lord will have the finest reward. As for those who do not respond to Him, even if they were to possess everything in the world twice over, they would certainly offer it to ransom themselves. They will face strict judgment, and Hell will be their home. What an evil place to rest!

Tafsir: For those who respond to their Lord those who answer Him by way of obedience there shall be the goodly reward Paradise and those who do not respond to Him namely the disbelievers — if they possessed all that is in the earth and therewith the like of it they would offer it to redeem themselves therewith against the chastisement. For such there shall be an awful reckoning and that is that they will be requited for every single thing they did none of which will be forgiven and their abode shall be Hell an evil resting place it is!

propositions: Those who respond to their Lord will receive a fine reward.
Even if someone possessed everything in the world, they would not be able to redeem themselves from punishment.
Hell is an evil place where those who do not respond to their Lord will reside.

source_text:
Verse: Can the one who knows that your Lord’s revelation to you ˹O Prophet˺ is the truth be like the one who is blind? None will be mindful ˹of this˺ except people of reason.

No! But only people of pith possessors of intellect remember heed such admonitions;

He is not like him who does not know it nor believes in it.
Only people of pith possessors of intellect remember heed such admonitions.

source_text:

source_text:

Responding to evil with good is crucial for those seeking a better hereafter.
Maintaining prayer and charity is key to a strong relationship with Allah.

source_text:
Verse: the Gardens of Eternity, which they will enter along with the righteous among their parents, spouses, and descendants. And the angels will enter upon them from every gate, ˹saying,˺

source_text:

source_text:
Verse: Allah gives abundant or limited provisions to whoever He wills. And the disbelievers become prideful of ˹the pleasures of˺ this worldly life. But the life of this world, compared to the Hereafter, is nothing but a fleeting enjoyment.

Tafsir: God expands provision He makes it abundant for whom He will and straitens restricts it for whomever He will; and they the people of Mecca rejoice a wanton rejoicing in the life of this world that is in what they acquire therein yet the life of this world in comparison with the life of the Hereafter is but a brief enjoyment a trifling thing enjoyed and then lost.

source_text:
Verse: The disbelievers say, “If only a sign could be sent down to him from his Lord.” Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Indeed, Allah leaves to stray whoever He wills, and guides to Himself whoever turns to Him—

Tafsir: And those who disbelieve from among the people of Mecca say ‘Why has not some sign like the staff and the glowing hand or the she-camel been sent down upon him upon Muhammad (s) from his Lord?’ Say to them ‘Indeed God sends astray whomever He will to send astray — such that signs cannot avail him in any way — and He guides He directs to Him to His religion those who turn in repentance’ those who return to Him man ‘those who’ is substituted by the following alladhīna ‘those who …’;

hype_questions: Does God not send any signs to guide him?

source_text:
Verse: those who believe and whose hearts find comfort in the remembrance of Allah. Surely in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find comfort.

God's remembrance brings reassurance to the hearts of believers.

source_text:
Verse: Those who believe and do good, for them will be bliss and an honourable destination.”

Tafsir: those who believe and perform righteous deeds alladhīna āmanū wa-‘amilū’l-sālihāt is the subject the predicate of which is the following theirs shall be blessedness tūbā is a verbal noun derived from tīb ‘goodness’ or the name of a tree in Paradise whose shade a mounted traveller travelling for 100 years would still not traverse and a fair resort a fair place to return to.

source_text:
Verse: And so We have sent you ˹O Prophet˺ to a community, like ˹We did with˺ earlier communities, so that you may recite to them what We have revealed to you. Yet they deny the Most Compassionate. Say, “He is my Lord! There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. In Him I put my trust, and to Him I turn ˹in repentance˺.”

Tafsir: Thus just as We sent prophets before you We have sent you to a community before whom other communities have passed away that you may recite to them that which We have revealed to you that is the Qur’ān; yet they disbelieve in the Compassionate One for when they were commanded to prostrate themselves to Him they said ‘And what is the Compassionate One?’ Say to them O Muhammad (s) ‘He is my Lord; there is no god save Him. In Him I trust and to Him is my recourse’.

hype_questions: What is the nature of Allah's compassion?
How can I trust in Allah when faced with challenges?
What is the significance of prostration to Allah?
propositions: Allah is my Lord and there is no god but Him.
I put my trust in Allah and turn to Him in repentance.
Prostration to Allah is a fundamental aspect of worship.

source_text:
Verse: If there were a recitation that could cause mountains to move, or the earth to split, or the dead to speak, ˹it would have been this Quran˺. But all matters are by Allah’s Will. Have the believers not yet realized that had Allah willed, He could have guided all of humanity? And disasters will continue to afflict the disbelievers or strike close to their homes for their misdeeds, until Allah’s promise comes to pass. Surely Allah never fails in His promise.

Tafsir: The following was revealed when they said to him ‘If you are truly a prophet then make these mountains of Mecca drift away before us and make for us rivers and springs in it that we may plant and sow seeds and resurrect for us our dead fathers to speak to us and tell us that you are a prophet’ Even if it were a Qur’ān whereby the mountains were set in motion moved from their places or the earth were cleft torn or the dead were spoken to such that they would respond they still would not believe. Nay but the affair belongs entirely to God and none other so that none believes except he whom He wills that he believes and no other; even if they were given what they request of signs. The following was revealed when the Companions were keen that what was requested of signs should be manifested hoping that they the ones requesting them might believe Have they not realised those who believe that an is softened in other words understand it as annahu had God willed He could have guided all mankind? to faith without the need for any sign? And the disbelievers from among the people of Mecca continue to be struck by devastation a catastrophe that devastates them through all manner of hardship such as being killed taken captive and suffering war or drought because of what they wrought because of their actions that is their disbelief; or you alight O Muhammad (s) together with your army near their home — Mecca — until God’s promise of victory against them comes to pass; truly God does not break His promise and indeed he alighted at Hudaybiyya until the conquest of Mecca took place;

hype_questions: Would the Quran be able to move mountains and resurrect the dead if it were recited?
Can a prophet truly make miracles happen to prove their claim?
Will Allah guide all of humanity to faith without any signs?
propositions: If there were a recitation that could cause mountains to move, or the earth to split, or the dead to speak, it would have been this Quran.
All matters are by Allah’s Will.
Had Allah willed, He could have guided all of humanity to faith without any signs.
Disasters will continue to afflict the disbelievers until Allah’s promise comes to pass.
None believes except he whom Allah wills that he believes.

source_text:
Verse: Other messengers had already been ridiculed before you, but I delayed the disbelievers ˹for a while˺ then seized them. And how ˹horrible˺ was My punishment!

Tafsir: messengers were certainly mocked before you in the same way that you have been mocked — this is meant as solace for the Prophet s — but I gave respite to those who disbelieved; then I seized them with retribution and how was My retribution? that is to say it My retribution will come to pass; and I shall deal with those who have mocked you in the same way.

hype_questions: Will my retribution come to pass?

Was the punishment of others a warning for me?
propositions: Other messengers had already been ridiculed before you.

Verse: Is ˹there any equal to˺ the Vigilant One Who knows what every soul commits? Yet the pagans have associated others with Allah ˹in worship˺. Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Name them! Or do you ˹mean to˺ inform Him of something He does not know on the earth? Or are these ˹gods˺ just empty words?” In fact, the disbelievers’ falsehood has been made so appealing to them that they have been turned away from the Path. And whoever Allah leaves to stray will be left with no guide.

Tafsir: Is He Who stands watches over every soul what it has earned? what it has done of good or evil — and this is God — like the idols who are not so? No! This response is suggested by the following words Yet they ascribe to God associates. Say ‘Name them! for Him who are they? Or will you inform Him will you inform God of something that is of an associate which He does not know in the earth? an interrogative of disavowal; in other words He has no associate for if He did He would know him — exalted be He above such a thing. Or is it — nay — you call them associates merely a manner of speaking?’ that is it is merely on the basis of false conjecture without any truth in it. Nay but their scheming their unbelief has been adorned for those who disbelieve and they have been barred from the way from the path of guidance; and whomever God sends astray for him there is no guide.

propositions: Allah is not difficult to please.
Faith in Allah is not hard.
God is not a demanding deity.

source_text:
Verse: They will all appear before Allah, and the lowly ˹followers˺ will appeal to the arrogant ˹leaders˺, “We were your ˹dedicated˺ followers, so will you ˹then˺ protect us from Allah’s torment in any way?” They will reply, “Had Allah guided us, we would have guided you. ˹Now˺ it is all the same for us whether we suffer patiently or impatiently, there is no escape for us.”

Tafsir: And they that is all creatures sally forth to God wa-barazū this and what follows is expressed in the past tense because it will come to pass all together; then the weak the followers say to those who were arrogant those who were followed ‘Indeed we were your followers taba‘an is the plural of tābi‘. Will you then avail defend us against the chastisement of God in any way?’ min ‘adhābi’Llāhi min shay’in the first min is explicative while the second one is partitive. They the ones followed say ‘If God had guided us we would have guided you we would have called you to right guidance. It is the same for us whether we rage impatiently or patiently endure; we do not have any asylum’ any refuge min mahīs ‘any asylum’ min is extra.

hype_questions: Will you protect us from Allah's torment in any way?
If God had guided us, we would have guided you.
Is there any asylum from the chastisement of God?
propositions: They will all appear before Allah.
We were your followers, so will you protect us from Allah's torment in any way?
Had Allah guided us, we would have guided you.
It is the same for us whether we suffer patiently or impatiently, there is no escape for us.

source_text:
Verse: And Satan will say ˹to his followers˺ after the judgment has been passed, “Indeed, Allah has made you a true promise. I too made you a promise, but I failed you. I did not have any authority over you. I only called you, and you responded to me. So do not blame me; blame yourselves. I cannot save you, nor can you save me. Indeed, I denounce your previous association of me with Allah ˹in loyalty˺. Surely the wrongdoers will suffer a painful punishment.”

Tafsir: And Satan Iblīs says when the issue has been decided and the people of Paradise are in Paradise and those of the Fire are in the Fire and they the people of the Fire have gathered round him ‘Truly God promised you a promise of truth regarding resurrection and requital fulfilling it to you; whereas I promised you that this would not be then failed you for over you I had no warrant min sultān min is extra no power or capacity to compel you to follow me except that I called you and you responded to me. So do not blame me but blame yourselves for having responded to me. I cannot heed your distress call I cannot bring aid to you nor can you heed mine read bi-musrikhiyya or bi-musrikhī. Lo! I disbelieved in your making me an associate of God formerly’ during life on earth. God exalted be He says Truly for the evildoers the disbelievers there shall be a painful chastisement.

hype_questions: What happens to those who follow Satan after judgment?
Can Satan save or be saved by humans?
Why do people blame others instead of themselves for their actions?
propositions: Allah promised a promise of truth regarding resurrection and requital.
Satan failed to fulfill his promise to humans.
Humans are responsible for responding to Satan's call.
God exalted be He says that the evildoers will face a painful chastisement.

source_text:
Verse: Those who believe and do good will be admitted into Gardens, under which rivers flow—to stay there forever by the Will of their Lord—where they will be greeted with “Peace!”

Tafsir: And those who believed and performed righteous deeds they are admitted to gardens underneath which rivers flow abiding khālidīna is a circumstantial qualifier of an implied situation therein by the leave of their Lord their greeting therein from God and from the angels and between themselves ‘Peace!’.

hype_questions: What happens to those who believe and do good?
How are believers rewarded in the afterlife?
What is the ultimate greeting for those who enter Paradise?
propositions: Those who believe and do good will be admitted into Gardens.
Gardens have rivers underneath them.
Believers are greeted with 'Peace!' by their Lord, God, and angels.

source_text:
Verse: Do you not see how Allah compares a good word to a good tree? Its root is firm and its branches reach the sky,

Tafsir: Have you not seen observed how God has struck a similitude? mathalan is substituted by the following words kalimatan tayyibatan a goodly saying which is ‘there is no god but God’ is as a goodly tree a palm tree its root set firm in the ground and its shoots its branches are in heaven;

hype_questions: Does a good word have a similar spiritual significance to a goodly tree?

Can a good word be compared to a goodly tree in terms of its spiritual impact?
propositions: A good word is like a good tree with a firm root and branches that reach the sky.
God has struck a similitude between a good word and a goodly tree, where the latter represents 'there is no god but God'.
The root of the palm tree is set firmly in the ground, just as the concept of Tawhid is firmly established.

source_text:
Verse: ˹always˺ yielding its fruit in every season by the Will of its Lord. This is how Allah sets forth parables for the people, so perhaps they will be mindful.

Tafsir: it gives its produce its fruit every season by the leave of its Lord by His will. Similarly the words of faith are set firm in the heart of the believer; his works are raised up to heaven and he receives the blessings and reward therefrom all the time. And God strikes He makes clear similitudes for mankind so that they might remember be admonished and therefore believe.

hype_questions: What is the purpose of Allah's parables?
How does faith impact a believer's works and rewards?
Why do God's similitudes matter for humanity?
propositions: The fruit of a tree yields its produce every season by the leave of its Lord.
Faith is set firm in the heart of the believer.
God strikes to make clear similitudes for mankind.

source_text:
Verse: And the parable of an evil word is that of an evil tree, uprooted from the earth, having no stability.

Tafsir: And the similitude of a bad saying that is the word of unbelief is as a bad tree a colocynth uprooted from upon the earth having no stability no fixing or foundation. Similarly the word of unbelief has no foundation and no shoot or blessing.

hype_questions: What is the consequence of a bad word in Islam?
How does unbelief affect an individual's life?
Can a person find stability and blessings through good words?
propositions: An evil word is like an evil tree uprooted from the earth, having no stability.
A bad saying that is the word of unbelief is as a colocynth uprooted from upon the earth having no stability or foundation.
The word of unbelief has no foundation and no shoot or blessing.

source_text:
Verse: Allah makes the believers steadfast with the firm Word ˹of faith˺ in this worldly life and the Hereafter. And Allah leaves the wrongdoers to stray. For Allah does what He wills.

Tafsir: God confirms those who believe by a firm saying namely the profession of His Oneness in the life of this world and in the Hereafter that is in the grave when the two angels question them about their Lord their religion and their Prophet and they respond correctly as reported in the hadīth of the two Shaykhs al-Bukhārī and Muslim; and God sends astray the evildoers the disbelievers and therefore they are not guided to the correct response saying instead ‘We do not know’ as reported in the hadīth; and God does what He will.

hype_questions: What is the firm Word of faith that Allah makes believers steadfast with?
How does God confirm those who believe in this worldly life and the Hereafter?
Why does God send astray the evildoers and disbelievers?
propositions: Allah makes the believers steadfast with the firm Word of faith in this worldly life.
God confirms those who believe by a firm saying namely the profession of His Oneness in the life of this world and in the Hereafter.
God sends astray the evildoers and disbelievers.

source_text:
Verse: Have you not seen those ˹disbelievers˺ who meet Allah’s favours with ingratitude and lead their own people to their doom?

Tafsir: Have you not seen observed those who exchanged God’s grace that is the thanks due for it for unthankfulness — these were the disbelievers of Quraysh — and who by leading them astray caused their people to take up residence in the Abode of Ruin?

hype_questions: What happens when people show ingratitude towards Allah's favours?
How do disbelievers lead their own people to destruction?
What is the consequence of causing others to take up residence in the Abode of Ruin?
propositions: Those who meet Allah’s favours with ingratitude exist.
Disbelievers exchanged God’s grace for unthankfulness.
Leading others astray causes their people to reside in the Abode of Ruin.

source_text:
Verse: In Hell they will burn. What an evil place for settlement.

Tafsir: Hell jahannama a supplement functioning as an explicative to which they shall be exposed admitted — an evil place to settle!

hype_questions: What is the nature of Jahannam?
Is Jahannam a place of settlement?

Hell is an evil place for settlement.

source_text:
Verse: They set up equals to Allah to mislead ˹others˺ from His Way. Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Enjoy yourselves! Surely your destination is the Fire.”

Tafsir: And they have set up rivals to associates with God that they might lead others astray read li-yadillū or li-yudillū from His way the religion of Islam. Say to them ‘Enjoy! this world of yours for a short time. For lo! your journey’s end your return shall be to the Fire!’.

hype_questions: What is the consequence of setting up rivals to Allah?

propositions: They set up equals to Allah to mislead others from His Way.
Enjoy yourselves! Surely your destination is the Fire.
This world of yours is but a short time, and your journey’s end your return shall be to the Fire!

source_text:
Verse: Tell My believing servants to establish prayer and donate from what We have provided for them—openly and secretly—before the arrival of a Day in which there will be no ransom or friendly connections.

Tafsir: Tell My servants who believe that they establish prayers and expend of that which We have provided them secretly and openly before a day comes wherein there will be neither bargaining ransoming nor befriending that is when there will not be any friendship of any benefit this is the Day of Resurrection.

hype_questions: What happens to those who establish their prayers and donate from what Allah has provided for them?

propositions: My servants who believe must establish prayers.

There will be no bargaining, ransoming, or befriending on the Day of Resurrection.

source_text:
Verse: It is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth and sends down rain from the sky, causing fruits to grow as a provision for you. He has subjected the ships for your service, sailing through the sea by His command, and has subjected the rivers for you.

Tafsir: God it is Who created the heavens and the earth and He sends down water from the heaven and with it He brings forth fruits as sustenance for you. And He has disposed for you the ships that they may run upon the sea laden with passengers and cargo at His commandment by His leave and He has disposed for you the rivers.

hype_questions: What is the purpose of Allah's creation?

propositions: Allah created the heavens and the earth.
Allah sends down rain from the sky, causing fruits to grow as a provision for humans.
Allah has subjected ships for human service, sailing through the sea by His command.
Allah has subjected rivers for human use.

source_text:
Verse: He has ˹also˺ subjected for you the sun and the moon, both constantly orbiting, and has subjected the day and night for you.

Tafsir: And He has disposed for you the sun and the moon constant moving in their courses without pause; and He has disposed for you the night that you may rest therein and the day that you may seek of His bounty therein.

hype_questions: What is the purpose of the sun and moon in our lives?

The day and night have been created for human rest and seeking blessings.
Rest is essential for humans to recharge.

source_text:
Verse: And He has granted you all that you asked Him for. If you tried to count Allah’s blessings, you would never be able to number them. Indeed humankind is truly unfair, ˹totally˺ ungrateful.

Tafsir: And He gives you of all that you ask of Him according to your individual best interests. And if you were to enumerate God’s graces meaning His bestowal of graces you could never number it you would not be able to count it. Lo! man the disbelieving man is verily a wrong-doer and unthankful! ever wronging his own soul through acts of disobedience and ungratefulness towards God’s grace.

hype_questions: What are the blessings that Allah has granted to humanity?

Humans cannot count the blessings of Allah due to their ingratitude.
Disobedience and ungratefulness towards Allah's grace lead to wronging one's own soul.

source_text:

Tafsir: And mention when Abraham said ‘My Lord make this land Mecca secure — God granted him this petition and thus made it Mecca a sanctuary in which no human blood is shed no person is wronged prey is not hunted and one which is never deserted in any of its parts — and turn me and my sons away from serving idols.

God granted Abraham's petition and made Mecca a sanctuary where no human blood is shed, no person is wronged, prey is not hunted, and it is never deserted.
Abraham was turned away from serving idols by God.

source_text:

Whoever follows me is with me, and whoever disobeys me—then surely You are All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
Idols have led many of mankind astray because of their worship of them.
Whoever follows me believing in the Oneness of God verily belongs with me belongs with those who follow my religion.
You are Forgiving Merciful this was before he was aware of the fact that God does not forgive idolatry.

source_text:
Verse: Our Lord! I have settled some of my offspring in a barren valley, near Your Sacred House, our Lord, so that they may establish prayer. So make the hearts of ˹believing˺ people incline towards them and provide them with fruits, so perhaps they will be thankful.

Tafsir: Our Lord indeed I have made some of my seed that is Ishmael and his mother Hagar to dwell in a valley where there is no sown land namely Mecca by Your Sacred House which had been there since before the Flood our Lord that they may establish prayer. So make some of the hearts of men yearn incline and long towards them — Ibn ‘Abbās said ‘Had He said “Make all the hearts of men …” assuredly the Persians the Byzantines and all of mankind would have yearned towards them’. And provide them with fruits that they might be thankful and this petition was granted for the town of al-Tā’if was transferred to that land.

hype_questions: What is the significance of establishing prayer in Islam?

propositions: Our Lord has settled some of my offspring in a barren valley near His Sacred House to establish prayer.
Allah made Ishmael and his mother Hagar dwell in a valley where there is no sown land, namely Mecca, for them to establish prayer.
Some of the hearts of men yearn and long towards those who establish prayer.
Allah provided fruits to those who establish prayer so that they might be thankful.

source_text:
Verse: Our Lord! You certainly know what we conceal and what we reveal. Nothing on earth or in heaven is hidden from Allah.

source_text:
Verse: All praise is for Allah who has blessed me with Ishmael and Isaac in my old age. My Lord is indeed the Hearer of ˹all˺ prayers.

Tafsir: Praise be to God Who has given me despite my old age Ishmael — born to him when he Abraham was 99 years old — and Isaac — born to him when he was 112 years old. Lo! my Lord is indeed the Hearer of supplication.

hype_questions: What is the significance of Ishmael and Isaac in Islamic tradition?

propositions: Allah has blessed me with Ishmael and Isaac despite my old age.
My Lord is the Hearer of prayers.
Ishmael was born to Abraham when he was 99 years old.
Isaac was born to Abraham when he was 112 years old.

source_text:
Verse: My Lord! Make me and those ˹believers˺ of my descendants keep up prayer. Our Lord! Accept my prayers.

Tafsir: My Lord make me an establisher of prayer and make of my seed those who will establish it the use of partitive min in min dhurriyatī ‘of my seed’ is because God informed him that some of them his seed would be disbelievers. Our Lord! And accept my supplication the supplication mentioned.

Our Lord! Accept my prayers.
God informed him that some of them his seed would be disbelievers.

source_text:
Verse: Our Lord! Forgive me, my parents, and the believers on the Day when the judgment will come to pass.”

Tafsir: Our Lord forgive me and my parents — this was before their enmity towards God Mighty and Majestic became clear; but it is also said that his mother submitted to God the alternative reading here being the singular wālidī ‘my father’; or yet another variant reading being waladī ‘my son’ and forgive believers on the day when the reckoning shall come to pass’ the day it shall be effected. God exalted be He says

hype_questions: What is the significance of parental obedience in Islam?

propositions: Our Lord forgives us.
The Prophet's mother submitted to God before her enmity became clear.
God exalted be He says.

source_text:
Verse: Do not think ˹O Prophet˺ that Allah is unaware of what the wrongdoers do. He only delays them until a Day when ˹their˺ eyes will stare in horror—

Tafsir: And do not suppose that God is heedless of what the evildoers the disbelievers from among the people of Mecca do. He but gives them respite without chastisement until a day when eyes shall stare wide-open because of the terror of what they see one says shakhasa basaru fulān to mean ‘he opened them his eyes and did not shut them’;

hype_questions: What happens to those who commit wrongdoings before the Day of Reckoning?

propositions: Allah is not unaware of the wrongdoings of people.
God gives respite to evildoers without chastisement until a day when they will see with wide-open eyes due to terror.
The eyes of those who disbelieve and do evil deeds will be open on the Day of Judgment.

source_text:
Verse: rushing forth, heads raised, never blinking, hearts void.

Tafsir: as they come hastening muhti‘īna is a circumstantial qualifier with their heads turned upwards to the heaven their gaze their sight returning not to them and their hearts as air devoid of any sense because of their being terror-stricken.

hype_questions: What is the state of those who are hastening towards death?
How do people's hearts behave when they are filled with terror?
What happens to a person's sight and gaze when they are consumed by fear?
propositions: They rush forth.
Their heads are raised.
Their hearts are void of any sense.
They are terror-stricken.
Their gaze is returning not to them.
Their sight is turning upwards to the heaven.

source_text:
Verse: And warn the people of the Day when the punishment will overtake ˹the wicked among˺ them, and the wrongdoers will cry, “Our Lord! Delay us for a little while. We will respond to Your call and follow the messengers!” ˹It will be said,˺ “Did you not swear before that you would never be removed ˹to the next life˺?”

Tafsir: And warn make them have fear O Muhammad (s) mankind the disbelievers of the day when chastisement will come upon them namely the Day of Resurrection and those who did evil who disbelieved will say ‘Our Lord give us respite by returning us to the world for a brief while that we might respond to Your call by affirming Your Oneness and follow the messengers’. It is then said to them in rebuke ‘But did you not use to swear formerly in the world that for you there would be no passing away? min zawālin min is extra from this world to the Hereafter?

hype_questions: Will the wicked be given a chance to respond to God's call before facing punishment?
Can those who disbelieve in the Hereafter be forgiven if they repent and follow the messengers?
What is the nature of the promise made by humans in this life that relates to the Afterlife?
propositions: The punishment will overtake the wicked on the Day of Resurrection.
Those who disbelieve will cry out for respite and affirmation of God's Oneness.
Humans swore in this life that they would not pass away, but this promise was never meant to be taken literally.

source_text:
Verse: You passed by the ruins of those ˹destroyed peoples˺ who had wronged themselves. It was made clear to you how We dealt with them, and We gave you ˹many˺ examples.

Tafsir: And you dwelt in it in the dwelling-places of those who wronged themselves through unbelief those from among communities of old and it became clear to you how We dealt with them by way of punishment — but you were not restrained thereby — and We struck made clear similitudes for you in the Qur’ān but you did not take heed.

hype_questions: What happens to those who wrong others?

propositions: You passed by the ruins of destroyed peoples who had wronged themselves.
We dealt with them through punishment.
We gave you many examples in the Qur'an to guide you.
You dwelt in the dwelling-places of those who wronged themselves through unbelief.
It became clear to you how We dealt with them by way of punishment — but you were not restrained thereby.

source_text:
Verse: They devised every plot, which was fully known to Allah, but their plotting was not enough to ˹even˺ overpower mountains ˹let alone Allah˺.

Tafsir: And verily they plotted against the Prophet s their plot — when they desired to kill him or detain him in his house or banish him — but their plotting is with God that is to say knowledge or the requital thereof is with God and their plotting even though it be great was not such whereby mountains should be moved meaning that it is not of any importance but that they are only harming themselves thereby. It is said that the use of ‘mountains’ here is meant to be literal; alternatively it is also said to be a reference to the laws of Islam which are likened to these mountains in the way that they are established and fixed a variant reading has la-tazūlu instead of li-tazūla with in softened from inna ‘verily’ in which case the intended meaning is that the extent of their plotting is great. It is said that ‘plotting’ here is actually a reference to their unbelief. This second reading is consonant with God’s saying Whereby the heavens are almost torn and the earth split asunder and the mountains fall crashing Q. 1990; according to the former reading however one should read it as if it were wa-mā kāna and their plotting was not such ….

hype_questions: Can any amount of plotting against a prophet change the course of events?
Is it possible for human actions to move mountains or alter the laws of Islam?
What is the true nature of plotting and its consequences in the eyes of God?
propositions: Their plotting was not enough to overpower Allah.
Knowledge and requital are with Allah.
Their plotting, even if great, is only harming themselves.

source_text:
Verse: So do not think ˹O Prophet˺ that Allah will fail to keep His promise to His messengers. Allah is indeed Almighty, capable of punishment.

Tafsir: So do not suppose that God will fail to keep His promise of victory to His messengers. Truly God is Mighty Victor nothing able to escape Him Lord of Retribution against those who disobey Him.

hype_questions: What happens if God fails to keep His promise?

Those who disobey God are subject to retribution.

source_text:
Verse: ˹Watch for˺ the Day ˹when˺ the earth will be changed into a different earth and the heavens as well, and all will appear before Allah—the One, the Supreme.

Tafsir: And mention the day when the earth will be changed to other than the earth and the heavens namely the Day of Resurrection mankind shall be gathered onto a white clear earth as reported in the hadīth of the two Shaykhs al-Bukhārī and Muslim. hype_questions: What will happen to humanity on the Day of Resurrection?

propositions: The earth and heavens will change on the Day of Resurrection.
Mankind will be gathered onto a white, clear earth on the Day of Resurrection.
People will come forth from their graves to meet God on the Day of Resurrection.

source_text:
Verse: On that Day you will see the wicked bound together in chains,

hype_questions: What will be the state of those who disbelieve on Judgment Day?
How will the wicked be treated on that day?

propositions: You will see the wicked bound together in chains.

source_text:

How does the fire punish its victims?
What happens to the faces of those who are punished?
propositions: Their shirts were made of pitch.

Their faces are engulfed by the Fire.

source_text:
Verse: As such, Allah will reward every soul for what it has committed. Surely Allah is swift in reckoning.

hype_questions: What will happen to every soul on the Day of Reckoning?

propositions: Allah will reward every soul for what it has committed.
God may requite li-yajziya is semantically connected to the verb barazū ‘they shall come forth’

source_text:
Verse: This ˹Quran˺ is a ˹sufficient˺ message for humanity so that they may take it as a warning and know that there is only One God, and so that people of reason may be mindful.

Tafsir: This Qur’ān is a Proclamation for mankind in other words it was revealed in order to proclaim to them and so that they may be warned thereby and that they may know by way of the arguments contained in it that He namely God is One God and that people of pith possessors of intellect may remember yadhdhakkara the original tā’ of yatadhakkara has been assimilated with the dhāl that they may be admonished.

hype_questions: What is the primary purpose of the Qur'an?
How does the Qur'an convey its message to humanity?

propositions: The Qur'an is a sufficient message for humanity.
